def solve(inp, anchor_bottom):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; pieces=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=inp[r][c]
            if v and v!=2 and not seen[r][c]:
                stack=[(r,c)]; comp=[]; seen[r][c]=True
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and inp[ny][nx]==v:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx))
                pieces.append((v,comp))
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for v,comp in pieces:
        for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=0
    key=(lambda p:-max(y for y,x in p[1])) if anchor_bottom else (lambda p:min(y for y,x in p[1]))
    for v,comp in sorted(pieces,key=key):
        while True:
            if anchor_bottom:
                if any(y+1>=H for y,x in comp) or any(out[y+1][x]!=0 for y,x in comp): break
                comp=[(y+1,x) for y,x in comp]
            else:
                if any(y-1<0 for y,x in comp) or any(out[y-1][x]!=0 for y,x in comp): break
                comp=[(y-1,x) for y,x in comp]
        for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=v
    return out
